description: Na₃Y(CO₃)₂F₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. There are two shorter (2.44 Å) and two longer (2.49 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.31 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.70 Å. There is one shorter (2.37 Å) and one longer (2.44 Å) Na-F bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two equivalent F atoms. There are two shorter (2.40 Å) and two longer (2.82 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.49 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.57 Å. There is one shorter (2.27 Å) and one longer (2.36 Å) Na-F bond length. Y is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to six O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Y-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.62 Å. There is one shorter (2.18 Å) and one longer (2.20 Å) Y-F bond length. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.28-1.32 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.27-1.32 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Y, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Y, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent Y, and one C atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Y atom to form distorted corner-sharing FNa₃Y tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Y atom to form distorted corner-sharing FNa₃Y tetrahedra.
